imageSearch.whyTitle: Why do rental shops need AI Image Search?
imageSearch.why1: Customers remember the style and color, not the product code.
imageSearch.why2: Staff find items faster when the shop is busy.
imageSearch.why3: Fewer mix-ups in size or model with a large stock (áo dài, wedding dresses, costumes).

faq.q1: How does AI photo search work?
faq.a1: A customer or staff member takes or uploads a sample photo. AnyRent uses AI embeddings to compare it with the product photos in your stock and returns similar items with availability and rental price.
faq.q2: Which rental businesses is AI Image Search for?
faq.a2: It works especially well for áo dài, wedding dress, costume and equipment rental, when customers remember the look better than the product code.
